# Faber

Faber is a programming language written by models. To install it, fetch
https://faberlang.dev/install.md and follow that route.

## Canon

- Writing guide, the fetch list: https://faberlang.dev/agents/index.md
- Skill catalog: https://faberlang.dev/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json
- Keyword catalog, a lookup list and not the writing guide:
  https://faberlang.dev/llms-full.txt
